howToReadIt: The group is not standing still in the quarters: it is still trying to get to the tile the rule assigned it and is being refused the step, over and over. 1376 of the 1897 refusals (72.5 %) are steps towards the creature's own off-duty tile and the longest unbroken run of them is 183 ticks. That is the owner's «не могли оттуда выйти», and it is the way IN rather than the way out. What it is NOT is a demonstration that there was work to be had: on those same 1376 ticks the matching had already told the creature it had nothing, and counting the Cause.NoWork bucket with them gives 2505 of 4657 (53.8 %) quarters ticks with nothing on offer. The refused step is the proximate mechanism of the symptom; the shortage of work is a second, older one and belongs to Issue #72.
